learningCurve.reason: durable observation, procedural, route-choice, trace, and model-runtime observation records append to Store logs; project_learning_from_store now replays those logs into a deterministic Store-derived learning and recurrence projection

dogfoodLessons.lesson: The local runtime contract is backend-neutral, but the first-class path is llama-cpp/GGUF, not ONNX-first.
Contract proof and execution proof are different things; a degraded/default build is honest, but it is not parity.
Token reduction can be real even when reranker lift is still zero, so those metrics must be tracked separately.
Model observations stay append-only first, then project into graph/memory views; the proof must distinguish persisted observation facts from derived graph curves.
A broad QA runner can create fabricated red by claiming rows it cannot prove; runner claim logic must be fixture-backed and leave unsupported rows unrunnable.
Runtime model proof must be CPU-first and one-model-at-a-time by default; GPU/NPU requires provider probes and child-process timeout protection.
Rollup proof must be derived from artifact evidence; stale pending rows can hide completed model, token, Store, RAG, dogfood, and parity work just as badly as fabricated green can overclaim it.
When a prefix flips from pending to artifact-backed green, rollup tests must update the derived signal assertion instead of preserving stale false expectations.
Coordination lane ids are not Git branch names; slash-bearing branch names must be recorded as branch metadata while lane uses a schema-valid id.
Compile-green harness changes can still violate test policy; no-test-doubles and weak-assertions must run on touched test files before commit.

Store-backed learning projection should clone a seed lesson graph and replay canonical Store observation logs into that projection; otherwise recurrence proof either mutates caller state or treats the in-memory graph as the source of truth.

followUps: Checked-in real model runtime proofs remain host-local and non-CI-parity; rerun explicit probes when hardware, cache, or providers change.
QA coverage is 54/250 runnable with 0 failures; unsupported rows remain unrunnable rather than fake green.
recurrenceNotes: t0 events now have durable Store append paths for observations and model-runtime incidents.
t1 proof exists through Store replay tests and clean source-shape/check gates.
t2 recurrence curves now come from project_learning_from_store, which replays Store logs into a deterministic projection before computing learning_curve and recurrence_curve.
